consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: thermal release during shift handover on SG-4100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on SG-4100 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during shift handover while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 14 April 2025 an incident occurred on SG-4100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
